component.name: Dotdeck
component.summary: Your OpenDots AI coworkers on the desktop
Seus colegas de IA do OpenDots no desktop
Tus compañeros de IA de OpenDots en el escritorio

description.p: Dotdeck is a native desktop client for OpenDots, the self-hosted workspace of always-on AI coworkers called Dots. Connect to your own server on this computer, your home network, Tailscale or the cloud, and keep your Dots one shortcut away.

O Dotdeck é um cliente desktop nativo para o OpenDots, o espaço de trabalho auto-hospedado de colegas de IA sempre ativos, os Dots. Conecte-se ao seu próprio servidor neste computador, na rede de casa, pelo Tailscale ou na nuvem, e deixe seus Dots a um atalho de distância.

Dotdeck es un cliente de escritorio nativo para OpenDots, el espacio de trabajo autoalojado de compañeros de IA siempre activos llamados Dots. Conéctate a tu propio servidor en este equipo, en la red de tu casa, por Tailscale o en la nube.

ul.li: A native sidebar with all your Dots, each with its pet, name and job
Barra lateral nativa com todos os seus Dots, cada um com pet, nome e função
Barra lateral nativa con todos tus Dots, cada uno con su mascota, nombre y función
Twelve plush pets, one for every Dot, chosen in a gallery
Doze pets de pelúcia, um para cada Dot, escolhidos numa galeria
Doce mascotas de peluche, una para cada Dot, elegidas en una galería
Advanced settings with search: Dots, voice and microphone, AI model, notifications per event, privacy and more
Configurações avançadas com busca: Dots, voz e microfone, modelo de IA, notificações por evento, privacidade e mais
Configuración avanzada con búsqueda: Dots, voz y micrófono, modelo de IA, notificaciones por evento, privacidad y más
Guided setup that tests the connection and finds the right address
Configuração guiada que testa a conexão e acha o endereço certo
Configuración guiada que prueba la conexión y encuentra la dirección correcta
Several servers, each with its own sign-in and data
Vários servidores, cada um com o seu acesso e os seus dados
Varios servidores, cada uno con su acceso y sus datos

Tokens de acesso guardados no chaveiro do sistema, nunca em texto puro
Tokens de acceso guardados en el llavero del sistema, nunca en texto plano
Voice calls with your Dots, with a native audio engine and echo cancellation
Chamadas de voz com os seus Dots, com motor de áudio nativo e cancelamento de eco
Llamadas de voz con tus Dots, con motor de audio nativo y cancelación de eco
Notifications when a Dot finishes or fails a task, or a scheduled task starts
Notificações quando um Dot termina ou falha uma tarefa, ou quando uma tarefa agendada começa
Notificaciones cuando un Dot termina o falla una tarea, o empieza una tarea programada

Atalhos globais: Super+Shift+D para mostrar o Dotdeck, mudo e aperte-para-falar

description.p: Dotdeck needs an OpenDots server. It is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by CopilotKit.
O Dotdeck precisa de um servidor OpenDots. É um projeto independente, sem vínculo com a CopilotKit.
Dotdeck necesita un servidor OpenDots. Es un proyecto independiente, sin relación con CopilotKit.

description.p: Voice calls cost less: each reply sends only what it needs.
Each Dot has its own voice in calls, and costs are in sight.

ul.li: Choose the call voice of each Dot in its settings.
The cost of the open conversation and of a call in progress, in the header.
What your OpenRouter key spent this month, under the model in the sidebar.
Voice calls hear when you stop talking in noisy rooms.

description.p: Every Dot setting now lives in Settings: MCP connections and Automatic Learning.

ul.li: Connections: add an MCP server and choose, tool by tool, Allowed, Ask First or Blocked.
Automatic Learning: the container ID and published skills, saved with the Dot.

description.p: A message box that grows with what you type.

ul.li: The message box grows line by line as you type, up to 40% of the window, then scrolls
It goes back to one line once the message is sent, and the conversation stays at its end while you type

description.p: Layout and usability polish.

ul.li: The Dot menu shows every option without scrolling, opens beside the pointer and also opens with Shift+F10 or the Menu key
Clearer call status in the header, a Call button that shows when a call is starting, and no Call while offline
Settings open tall enough to show every section, and narrow windows fit better
Reloading the page ends a call cleanly, and many labels read better in Portuguese

description.p: Calls that sound like calls.

ul.li: A soft ring while the call connects, a short chime when it is live and a falling tone when it ends; turn them off in Voice Calls › Call Sounds
The Dot answers the call with one short sentence
The voice gateway now hears the end of what you say on real headsets, even with background hum

description.p: An official website and new screenshots.

ul.li: Dotdeck has an official website, linked from its page in the software center
New screenshots, including the AI Models and Voice Calls pages
Portuguese labels that the default GNOME font cut short now fit

description.p: Voice calls fixed.

ul.li: Calling a Dot no longer fails with "Dotdeck only carries the microphone in calls" on busy pages: the microphone hand-off now survives WebKit's memory clean-up

description.p: Clearer AI models.

ul.li: The new AI Models page names the model your Dots chat with, shows its approximate price per million tokens and whether its key is set, and tests it with one click
Choose the provider: OpenRouter, Anthropic with your own API key (Claude Haiku, Sonnet and Opus), or any OpenAI-compatible server, with one key per provider
See the three models of a voice call (speech, transcription and research) and switch the speech model on the Voice Calls page
The sidebar shows which model the Dots are using

description.p: The Snap package opens its window again, without needing any extra permission.
Fixes the Snap package, which could not open its window.
A redesigned workspace.

ul.li: A native sidebar with all your Dots, each with its pet, name and job, plus Spaces, Activity and Memories
Twelve new plush pets: every Dot gets its own, and you can change it in the pet gallery
A new Settings window with sections and search: appearance, notifications per event, Dots, voice and microphone, AI model, servers, privacy and diagnostics
Call a Dot from the header, the sidebar or the tray, with a call timer and microphone controls
Keyboard shortcuts to search, switch and call Dots

description.p: Updates and voice for your server.

ul.li: Check the official OpenDots for news and update your server with one click, keeping local changes and undoing a failed update automatically
Voice calls with only an OpenRouter key, through the new server voice gateway
Voice call status for the server in Preferences

description.p: First release.

ul.li: Guided setup, several servers and tokens in the keyring
Native voice calls for OpenDots, which WebKitGTK cannot place on its own
Notifications, tray icon, background mode and global shortcuts
